verses.original: דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ ע֥וֹד וַיֹּ֨סֶף בָּח֥וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ כָּל־
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ‘ō·wḏ way·yō·sep̄ bā·ḥūr bə·yiś·rā·’êl šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄ kāl-
verses.literal: David - again assembled [the] chosen [men] of Israel thirty thousand in all

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ דָּוִ֗ד וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִֽבַּעֲלֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֣א שֵׁ֗ם שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw way·yê·leḵ mib·ba·‘ă·lê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ miš·šām ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- niq·rā šêm šêm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yō·šêḇ hak·kə·ru·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: - And he and all his troops - - set out vvv for Baale of Judah to bring up from there - the ark of God which is called by the Name the name of the LORD of Hosts who is enthroned between the cherubim that are on it

verses.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֜בוּ אֶת־ אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ חֲדָשָׁ֔ה עֲגָלָ֣ה וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֔הוּ מִבֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֗וֹ בְּנֵי֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב נֹהֲגִ֖ים אֶת־ חֲדָשָֽׁה׃ הָעֲגָלָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·yar·ki·ḇū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ḥă·ḏā·šāh ‘ă·ḡā·lāh way·yiś·śā·’u·hū mib·bêṯ ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·šer bag·giḇ·‘āh wə·‘uz·zā wə·’aḥ·yōw bə·nê ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ nō·hă·ḡîm ’eṯ- ḥă·ḏā·šāh hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh
verses.literal: They set - the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab which was on the hill Uzzah and Ahio the sons of Abinadab were guiding - the new cart

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֗הוּ עִ֖ם אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מִבֵּ֤ית אֲבִֽינָדָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה וְאַחְי֕וֹ הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā·’u·hū ‘im ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mib·bêṯ ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·šer bag·giḇ·‘āh wə·’aḥ·yōw hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn
verses.literal: bringing with it the ark of God - - - - And Ahio was walking in front of the ark

verses.original: וְדָוִ֣ד׀ וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַֽׂחֲקִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים וּבְכִנֹּר֤וֹת וּבִנְבָלִים֙ וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְנַֽעַנְעִ֖ים וּֽבְצֶלְצֶלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mə·śa·ḥă·qîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·ḵōl ‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ū·ḇin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇim·na·‘an·‘îm ū·ḇə·ṣel·ṣe·lîm
verses.literal: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments . . . harps stringed instruments tambourines sistrums and cymbals

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ גֹּ֣רֶן נָכ֑וֹן עֻזָּ֜א וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֶל־ וַיֹּ֣אחֶז בּ֔וֹ אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ כִּ֥י הַבָּקָֽר׃ שָׁמְט֖וּ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- gō·ren nā·ḵō·wn ‘uz·zā way·yiš·laḥ ’el- way·yō·ḥez bōw ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî hab·bā·qār šā·mə·ṭū
verses.literal: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon Uzzah reached out - and took hold of the ark of God because the oxen had stumbled

verses.original: אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ וַיִּֽחַר־ בְּעֻזָּ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ שָׁ֛ם עַל־ הַשַּׁ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- bə·‘uz·zāh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yak·kê·hū šām ‘al- haš·šal way·yā·māṯ šām ‘im ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah and God struck him down on the spot for his irreverence and he died there beside the ark of God

verses.original: לְדָוִ֔ד וַיִּ֣חַר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה פָּרַ֧ץ פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֞א הַהוּא֙ לַמָּק֤וֹם פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔ה עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yi·ḥar ‘al ’ă·šer Yah·weh pā·raṣ pe·reṣ bə·‘uz·zāh way·yiq·rā ha·hū lam·mā·qō·wm pe·reṣ ‘uz·zāh ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then David became angry because - the LORD had burst forth . . . against Uzzah So he named that place vvv Perez-uzzah as it is [called] to this day

verses.original: הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם דָוִ֛ד אֶת־ וַיִּרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֛יךְ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃ יָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ḏā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·yi·rā Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’êḵ ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w ’ê·lay
verses.literal: That day David - feared the LORD and asked How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me

verses.original: דָוִ֗ד וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֣ה לְהָסִ֥יר אֵלָ֛יו אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד דָוִ֔ד וַיַּטֵּ֣הוּ בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־ אֱד֖וֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḏā·wiḏ wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh lə·hā·sîr ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh ‘al- ‘îr dā·wiḏ ḏā·wiḏ way·yaṭ·ṭê·hū bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm hag·git·tî
verses.literal: So he vvv was unwilling to move . . . - the ark of the LORD to the City of David instead, he took it aside to the house vvv of Obed-edom the Gittite

verses.original: אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ בֵּ֣ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם הַגִּתִּ֖י שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh way·yê·šeḇ bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm hag·git·tî šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·ḇā·reḵ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- kāl- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Thus the ark of the LORD remained in the house vvv of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months and the LORD - blessed vvv [him] - and all his household

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ בֵּרַ֣ךְ בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים דָּוִ֗ד וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים וַיַּעַל֩ אֶת־ מִבֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lam·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ lê·mōr Yah·weh ’eṯ- bê·raḵ bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm dā·wiḏ way·yê·leḵ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘al ’eṯ- mib·bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm ‘îr dā·wiḏ bə·śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: Now it was reported to King David . . . The LORD - has blessed the house vvv of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him because of the ark of God So David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house vvv of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֧י נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָ֖ה צָעֲד֛וּ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה צְעָדִ֑ים וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח שׁ֖וֹר וּמְרִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn- Yah·weh ṣā·‘ă·ḏū šiš·šāh ṣə·‘ā·ḏîm way·yiz·baḥ šō·wr ū·mə·rî
verses.literal: - When those carrying the ark of the LORD had advanced six paces he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf

verses.original: וְדָוִ֛ד וְדָוִ֕ד חָג֖וּר בָּֽד׃ אֵפ֥וֹד מְכַרְכֵּ֥ר בְּכָל־ עֹ֖ז לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·ḏā·wiḏ ḥā·ḡūr bāḏ ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ mə·ḵar·kêr bə·ḵāl ‘ōz lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And David - wearing a linen ephod danced with all his might before the LORD

verses.original: וְדָוִד֙ וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַעֲלִ֖ים אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה וּבְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ma·‘ă·lîm ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh biṯ·rū·‘āh ū·ḇə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: while he and all the house of Israel brought up - the ark of the LORD with shouting and the sounding of the ram’s horn

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד שָׁא֜וּל בַּת־ וּמִיכַ֨ל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה׀ בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מְפַזֵּ֤ז וּמְכַרְכֵּר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh bā ‘îr dā·wiḏ šā·’ūl baṯ- ū·mî·ḵal niš·qə·p̄āh bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn wat·tê·re ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ mə·p̄az·zêz ū·mə·ḵar·kêr lip̄·nê Yah·weh wat·ti·ḇez lōw bə·lib·bāh
verses.literal: - As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw - King David leaping and dancing before the LORD and she despised him in her heart

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֜אוּ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וַיַּצִּ֤גוּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּמְקוֹמ֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּוִ֑ד נָטָה־ ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֥ד וַיַּ֨עַל עֹל֛וֹת וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh way·yaṣ·ṣi·ḡū ’ō·ṯōw bim·qō·w·mōw bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel ’ă·šer dā·wiḏ nā·ṭāh- lōw dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So they brought - the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD

verses.original: דָּוִ֔ד וַיְכַ֣ל מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעוֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·ḵal mê·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·šêm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings he blessed - the people in the name of the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וַיְחַלֵּ֨ק לְכָל־ הָעָ֜ם לְמֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁה֒ לְאִ֗ישׁ לְכָל־ הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ אַחַ֔ת חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֶחָ֔ד וְאֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֑ת וַאֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal·lêq lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh lə·’îš lə·ḵāl hă·mō·wn yiś·rā·’êl ’a·ḥaṯ ḥal·laṯ le·ḥem ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’eš·pār ’e·ḥāṯ wa·’ă·šî·šāh kāl- hā·‘ām way·yê·leḵ ’îš lə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then he distributed to every . . . man and woman among the multitude of Israel a loaf of bread a date cake and a raisin cake And all the people departed each to his own home

verses.original: דָּוִ֖ד וַיָּ֥שָׁב לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ בֵּית֑וֹ שָׁאוּל֙ לִקְרַ֣את בַּת־ מִיכַ֤ל וַתֵּצֵ֞א דָּוִ֔ד מַה־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נִּכְבַּ֨ד הַיּ֜וֹם וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִגְלָ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ לְעֵינֵ֨י אַמְה֣וֹת עֲבָדָ֔יו אַחַ֥ד הָרֵקִֽים׃ כְּהִגָּל֥וֹת נִגְל֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yā·šāḇ lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw šā·’ūl liq·raṯ baṯ- mî·ḵal wat·tê·ṣê dā·wiḏ mah- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl niḵ·baḏ hay·yō·wm wat·tō·mer ’ă·šer niḡ·lāh hay·yō·wm lə·‘ê·nê ’am·hō·wṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’a·ḥaḏ hā·rê·qîm kə·hig·gā·lō·wṯ niḡ·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: When David returned home to bless - his own household Saul’s . . . daughter Michal came out to meet him How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today she said He has uncovered himself today in the sight of the maidservants of his subjects like a vulgar person would [do] . . .

verses.original: דָּוִד֮ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ מִיכַל֒ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּֽחַר־ בִּ֤י מֵֽאָבִיךְ֙ וּמִכָּל־ בֵּית֔וֹ לְצַוֺּ֨ת אֹתִ֥י נָגִ֛יד עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשִׂחַקְתִּ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ’el- mî·ḵal lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bā·ḥar- bî mê·’ā·ḇîḵ ū·mik·kāl- bê·ṯōw lə·ṣaw·wōṯ ’ō·ṯî nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- Yah·weh ‘al- ‘am yiś·rā·’êl wə·śi·ḥaq·tî lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: But David said to Michal I was dancing before the LORD who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s . . . people Israel I will celebrate before the LORD

verses.original: וּנְקַלֹּ֤תִי וְהָיִ֥יתִי שָׁפָ֖ל בְּעֵינָ֑י עוֹד֙ מִזֹּ֔את אִכָּבֵֽדָה׃ וְעִם־ הָֽאֲמָהוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתְּ עִמָּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·qal·lō·ṯî wə·hā·yî·ṯî šā·p̄āl bə·‘ê·nāy ‘ō·wḏ miz·zōṯ ’ik·kā·ḇê·ḏāh wə·‘im- hā·’ă·mā·hō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·mart ‘im·mām
verses.literal: and I will humiliate . . . and humble myself even more than this Yet I will be honored by the maidservants of whom you have spoken . . .

verses.original: וּלְמִיכַל֙ בַּת־ שָׁא֔וּל הָ֥יָה לָ֖הּ לֹֽא־ יָ֑לֶד עַ֖ד י֥וֹם מוֹתָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl hā·yāh lāh lō- yā·leḏ ‘aḏ yō·wm mō·w·ṯāh
verses.literal: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death
